narration.full_text: Now, let's quickly review some key concepts from trigonometry. We'll go through some flashcards to help solidify your understanding of trigonometric ratios. Remember, these ratios are fundamental to solving problems involving right-angled triangles. Pay close attention to the definitions and how they relate to the sides of a triangle. This review will help you recall the essential relationships between angles and sides.
